# Aipo Documentation — Agent and LLM Index

> Language: Aipo. Repository: https://github.com/poppy-team/aipo-lang
> This portal is in website/; existing docs/ and tests remain.
> Approved syntax targets are not proof of implementation. Never claim tests passed without evidence.

## Documentation entry points
- Overview: / 
- Learning book: /learn/
- Practical guides: /guides/
- Language and CLI reference: /reference/
- Implementation status: /reference/status
- Concepts and rationale: /concepts/
- Compiler engineering: /engineering/
- Documentation archive and migration: /archive/

## Agent protocol
- Start: /engineering/agents/
- Read progressively: /engineering/agents/reading
- Implementation and evidence: /engineering/agents/workflows
- Relevant Prumo skills: /engineering/agents/prumo
- Scoped prompt patterns: /engineering/agents/prompts
- Semantic conflicts: /engineering/decisions/conflicts
- Test & quality gates: /engineering/quality

## Authority
- Existing language decision: https://github.com/poppy-team/aipo-lang/blob/main/docs/decisions/adr-001-canonical-syntax.md
- Current target syntax and known drift: https://github.com/poppy-team/aipo-lang/blob/main/SYNTAX.md
- Conformance fixtures: https://github.com/poppy-team/aipo-lang/tree/main/docs/conformance
- Actual behavior comes from code, fixtures and verified execution at a specific SHA.
- Prumo workforce is an external reference, not automatic permission to execute code.

## Guidelines
Select one task domain, read only its boundary and applicable decision, inspect relevant code and tests, then establish a measurable delta. Preserve legacy documentation until its references and authority conflicts are reconciled.
